name: pump_surf_executor
summary: Consumes XGBoost gate decisions from pump_xgboost_gate (parallel agent D) and emits BUY/SELL orders against pump.fun / PumpSwap via the surf strategy: follow large bot-driven volume on fresh mints, ride the human-inflow wake, exit before bots dump. STRICT DRY-RUN DEFAULT: every order returns dry_run=True UNLESS all three gates are open: SOLANA_NETWORK=mainnet-beta AND PUMP_SURF_LIVE_TRADING=1 AND confirm=True. Any missing condition forces DRY-RUN regardless. Per-trade SOL cap (default 0.1) and per-day SOL cap (default 1.0, tracked in ~/.cc/pump_surf_daily.json) enforced before any live execution. Every order (DRY-RUN or live, refused or accepted) crystal-anchors via inference_logger with tier='trade_action', model='pump_surf', scope='buy'|'sell'.
engine_pattern: Stdlib-only Python module (json, time, pathlib, os, dataclasses, uuid, argparse). Mirrors the topstep_mcp double-gate pattern but extends it to TRIPLE-gate (network + flag + confirm) because Solana mainnet exposure is binary on-chain whereas TopstepX has DRY-RUN built into its sandbox. Public API: consider_buy / consider_sell / execute_dryrun_or_live / surf_loop. CLI: status / order-log / simulate --replay <jsonl> / buy --mint --sol --target-wallet [--confirm]. Live execution path (solana_mcp.transfer to PumpSwap router) is INTENTIONALLY UNWIRED in this executor per scope constraints; if all 3 gates open the order is demoted to DRY-RUN with error='live_path_not_wired:solana_mcp_invocation_out_of_scope' so an audit row still lands.

safety_rails.gate_logic: ALL THREE must be true for a real on-chain swap. Any missing => DRY-RUN regardless. No exceptions, no override path.

per_trade_cap.behavior: any order request > cap returns order.error='exceeds_per_trade_cap' and is demoted to DRY-RUN. The audit row still lands so the refusal is crystal-anchored.

per_day_cap.ledger_format: JSON dict keyed by UTC date YYYY-MM-DD -> {sol_in: float, trades: int}
per_day_cap.behavior: before a live BUY can fire, used_today + requested_sol must be <= cap. Otherwise order.error='exceeds_per_day_cap' and demoted to DRY-RUN. DRY-RUN orders do NOT increment the daily ledger (so simulate/replay does not pollute the cap).

safety_rails.console_message: DRY-RUN: would have placed buy 0.5 SOL of mint <x>  written to stderr on every dry-run order; matches the topstep_mcp pattern.
safety_rails.live_execution_status: NOT WIRED IN THIS EXECUTOR. Solana mainnet swap path (solana_mcp.transfer -> PumpSwap router or pump.fun program) is intentionally unimplemented per task constraints (do NOT touch solana_mcp.py). If all 3 gates open, the order is logged with error='live_path_not_wired:solana_mcp_invocation_out_of_scope' and demoted to DRY-RUN. Future patch will wire the swap call.

returns_refused_order_when: live + sol_amount would exceed per-day cap (error='exceeds_per_day_cap')
buy_decision_table.rationale_format: echoes gate_decision.rationale if present, else default 'bot_volume+human_inflow above surf threshold'

fires_when_any_true: bot_prob > 0.95 AND latest_human_inflow < 0.15 - bot exit imminent, no buyers left
time-in-position > 30 minutes - hard timeout regardless of signal
sell_decision_table.rationale_format: pipe-joined list of triggered conditions, e.g. 'human_inflow_flatline:3>=3 | hard_timeout:1900s>1800s'

public_api: SurfOrder (dataclass) - ts, kind, mint, sol_amount, target_wallet, bot_prob, human_inflow, rationale, dry_run, tx_signature, crystal, error
SurfState (dataclass) - active_position, position_mint, position_sol_in, position_entry_ts, last_human_inflow, consecutive_flat_ticks
GateDecision (dataclass) - stub of the type parallel agent D will produce; defined locally so this module imports without the gate landing first
consider_sell(current_state, latest_human_inflow, latest_bot_prob, exit_thresholds=None, confirm=False) -> Optional[SurfOrder]

crystal_anchor.coordinates: [{axis: 'dry_run', value: 1 if order.dry_run else 0}] so audit walks can split dry-run from live without parsing output_text

env_vars.SOLANA_NETWORK: must equal 'mainnet-beta' for gate #1 of 3 to open
env_vars.PUMP_SURF_LIVE_TRADING: must equal '1' for gate #2 of 3 to open; default unset = DRY-RUN forever
env_vars.PUMP_SURF_MAX_SOL_PER_DAY: per-day SOL cap, default 1.0; tracked in ~/.cc/pump_surf_daily.json

storage.daily_ledger: ~/.cc/pump_surf_daily.json    (atomic write via .tmp + replace; UTC date keyed)

cli.status: python3 core/lib/pump_surf_executor.py status                       (active position + daily cap usage)
cli.simulate: python3 core/lib/pump_surf_executor.py simulate --replay <jsonl>    (replay gate decisions, all DRY-RUN unless --confirm + env)
cli.buy: python3 core/lib/pump_surf_executor.py buy --mint <X> --sol 0.05 --target-wallet <Y> [--confirm]  (DRY-RUN unless all 3 gates open)

substrate: consumes pump_xgboost_gate.GateDecision  emits SurfOrder  writes ~/.cc/pump_surf_orders.jsonl + ~/.cc/pump_surf_daily.json  crystal-anchors via inference_logger. Read-only of solana_mcp (untouched per scope). Read-only of pump_xgboost_gate / pump_gmm_classifier (types stubbed locally until they land).

outbound_calls: (live mode only, future) solana_mcp.transfer to swap SOL <-> mint via PumpSwap router or pump.fun program
routing_connections.substrate_reads: env vars only (SOLANA_NETWORK, PUMP_SURF_LIVE_TRADING, PUMP_SURF_MAX_SOL_PER_TRADE, PUMP_SURF_MAX_SOL_PER_DAY); plus ~/.cc/pump_surf_daily.json for cap check.

guarantees: DRY-RUN by default - real orders require ALL THREE of SOLANA_NETWORK=mainnet-beta, PUMP_SURF_LIVE_TRADING=1, confirm=True
Crystal-anchored - every order (DRY-RUN, refused, or live) writes one InferenceRecord with tier='trade_action', model='pump_surf'
Stdlib-only - no pip packages; json, time, pathlib, os, dataclasses, uuid, argparse only
Solana keys never touched - this executor reads no wallet material; live path delegates to solana_mcp.transfer (unwired here)
Per-trade cap enforced - any sol_amount > PUMP_SURF_MAX_SOL_PER_TRADE returns error='exceeds_per_trade_cap'
Per-day cap enforced - live BUY refused if daily_used + sol_amount would exceed PUMP_SURF_MAX_SOL_PER_DAY
Append-only orders log - ~/.cc/pump_surf_orders.jsonl is never rewritten
Atomic daily ledger - write to .tmp + replace so a crash mid-write does not corrupt the file
